# Roxy Dark – GRUB theme
# Colors from themes/roxy.json. The fonts (roxy-*.pf2) are generated by
# `roxy grub` from JetBrains Mono, so they are not part of the repo.
# Layout: header top left, a labeled box with the boot menu in the center,
# countdown text, key hints and a thin progress bar below the box.

terminal-height: "80%"
terminal-border: "0"
